{{Quote|Why did the Jedi choose such a hazardous spot to keep the Ilum crystals?''"<br />"''The crystals grow in a cave at the top of this cliff. That is where we must gather them. The challenge is part of the reward.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Path to Truth" />}}
'''Ilum crystals''' were the most common [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] used amongst the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] until up to the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Found in [[Crystal Cave/Legends|crystal caves]] on the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], they were similar in structure to the [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]] variants of mephite and pontite, which produced the best [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blades. However, while those crystals were rare even in the [[Adega system/Legends|Adega system]], Ilum presented to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] entire caves full of high-quality crystals. Most Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] underwent the ritual on construction of their first lightsaber at Ilum.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==

The term "Ilum crystal" was created by comicbook writer [[Tom Veitch]] as a generic name for all naturally-formed lightsaber crystals, in the [[Dark Empire endnotes|endnotes]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire|Dark Empire]]'' [[Star Wars: Dark Empire (trade paperback)|trade paperback]]. The alternative name "Adegan crystal" was maintained from the original endnotes in [[Dark Empire 4|''Dark Empire'' 4]], referring to the system in which these crystals were most commonly found, thus making the terms Adegan, Ilum and lightsaber crystal synonymous.<ref name="DE">[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]] [[1993]] first edition and [[1995]] second edition [[Star Wars: Dark Empire (trade paperback)|trade paperback]]</ref> However, with the later introduction of a crystal-rich planet called Ilum into [[Star Wars Legends|continuity]],<ref name="Path to Truth" /> an in-universe explanation was provided for the terms being used interchangeably, namely that crystals from the newly discovered Ilum were so similar in structure to variants from the Adegan system, that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] took them to be the same at first.<ref name="JATM" />
